newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission may make announcement on Telekom Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Commission may make announcement on Telekom Thursday.

text.p: The European Commission may make an announcement on Thursday on Deutsche Telekom's price discounts for big customers, a Commission official said on Wednesday.
"There may be some sort of announcement tomorrow," the official said, declining to elaborate.

The Commission has been in regular contact with the German government and particularly Post & Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch over the issue after Telekom's competitors filed a complaint to have the discounts plans delayed.
The official said Boetsch had written to the Commission advising it of a letter sent to the plaintiffs. The Commission had replied to Boetsch and was now waiting for a " definitive answer".
The German Handelsblatt daily newspaper reported on Wednesday that Deutsche Telekom was going ahead with the controversial discounts of up to 35 percent for big customers.
Quoting a Telekom spokesman, Handelsblatt said the company had won the approval of Boetsch for the discounts, which are due to be introduced on November 1.

The Commission cleared the discounts policy plan earlier this year on the condition in particular that Germany grant two telecoms licences and encourage negotiations between Telekom and its new rivals on interconnection rights.
State-owned Telekom is in the midst of its initial public offering, Europe's largest ever privatisation, and its shares will start trading on November 18.
